updates.note: Management stated they expect the working capital cycle to settle within their long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Reiterated export guidance going north of 10% of overall top line by 2030.
updates.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.

updates.note: Reiterated FMEG EBITDA margin guidance of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
updates.quote: where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

updates.note: Reiterated strategic priority to grow FMEG at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth.
updates.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.

updates.note: Reiterated INR 4,500 crores execution piece for Bharat Net over 3 years.
updates.quote: So there is a INR 4,500 crores execution piece of the contract of INR 8,000 crores overall.

updates.note: Reiterated sustainable operating margins for EPC in high single-digit range.
updates.quote: we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.

new_promises.statement: Maintain medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for the Wires & Cables business.
new_promises.quote: we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Expect around INR 800-odd crores to translate this year from Bharat Net and RDSS.
new_promises.quote: we should expect about INR 800-odd crores translating this year.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
